title: 11 Killed as Israeli Strike Levels Residential Building in Kfar Reman
detail: Israeli warplanes hit a residential building early Monday in Kfar Reman, killing 11 people — including two children — and wounding five others, per Lebanon's Health Ministry. In a separate strike, an Israeli drone hit a civilian vehicle in Nabatieh province, killing at least one medic, according to Lebanon's National News Agency. Demolitions were also reported in al-Mansouri and strikes hit Deir al-Zahrani. The three-day toll across the Nabatieh region reached at least 27 killed and 69 wounded. President Joseph Aoun said 'these attacks target the framework agreement process and undermine all efforts to halt the escalation.' Al Jazeera's Zeina Khodr reported that 'the feeling here is that Israel is trying to impose or establish new rules of engagement.'

media.caption: Aftermath of the Israeli strike on a residential building in Kfar Reman, Sep 7, 2026
